units.source_text: 虽然她自己并不自觉，但她总是以大自然的峡谷作为自己的听众，孤独地练习弹奏。

en.t: Though she herself was unaware of it, she always practiced playing alone, taking the great natural ravines as her audience.

units.source_text: 久而久之，她的弹拨自然就有力量。

en.t: Over time, her playing naturally gained strength.

units.source_text: 这种孤独驱散了哀愁，蕴含着一种豪放的意志。

en.t: This solitude dispelled sorrow and held within it a bold, unrestrained will.

units.source_text: 虽说多少有点基础，但独自依靠谱子来练习复杂的曲子，甚至离开谱子还能弹拨自如，这无疑需要有坚强的意志和不懈的努力。

en.t: Even if she had some foundation, practicing complex pieces alone from the score, and even playing freely without it, surely required strong will and unremitting effort.
